_Comment: Production configuration for IIS deployment. Paths are relative to the app directory so they work regardless of where you deploy.
_FeaturesComment: LEGACY: Only 'EnforceCompanyScope' is read from this section. All FF_* flags are in the DATABASE (seeded on first run, all enabled). To change flags after deployment: Owner > Feature Flags page.
_FeatureFlagDefaultsComment_1: REFERENCE ONLY — this section is NOT read by code.
_FeatureFlagDefaultsComment_2: Feature flags are stored in the SQLite database (FeatureFlags table), seeded by Data/SeedData/FeatureFlagSeed.cs on first run (all enabled).
_FeatureFlagDefaultsComment_3: To change after deployment: log in as Owner > Feature Flags page. If flags are wrong, the startup log will show a WARNING.
